free_tier_limits: Free for authenticated not-for-profit use under fair-use and query-volume limits. High-value contributors may receive discretionary free access beyond those limits. Commercial or for-profit use may require a paid Spamhaus subscription.
rate_limits: No API-wide requests-per-minute quota is published. Database dumps should not be fetched more than once every 5 minutes; recent-URL and recent-payload queries return at most 1,000 entries.
description: URLhaus is a malware-URL intelligence platform operated by abuse.ch and Spamhaus. Its APIs support querying and downloading intelligence and submitting URLs directly used to distribute malware. Phishing sites and phishing-kit hosts are explicitly outside its submission scope.
resolution_notes: free_tier_limits: original overstated commercial restrictions; current terms say commercial use may require payment and define fair-use/query limits. https://abuse.ch/terms-of-use/ rate_limits: endpoint-specific limits exist, so "not published" is incorrect. https://urlhaus.abuse.ch/api/ and https://urlhaus-api.abuse.ch/ description: phishing is explicitly excluded; URLhaus is operated by abuse.ch and Spamhaus. https://urlhaus.abuse.ch/api/ and https://urlhaus.abuse.ch/about/
